Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated experience providing administrative or executive-level support.
Experience managing website content using WordPress and maintaining email listservs via Google Groups.

Provide executive and administrative support by managing calendars, scheduling stakeholder meetings, tracking action items, maintaining shared files, and preparing presentations and briefing materials.

Execute internal and external communications by updating the website, managing LinkedIn presence, drafting stakeholder outreach, and coordinating messaging with UCI Strategic Communications and Government Relations.

Coordinate programs and events by assisting with early planning for the annual Climate Collaboration Symposium, the Climate Solutions Series, Climate + Arts programming, and stakeholder lunches or dinners.
Support student initiatives by coordinating with graduate students in the UCI Climate Storytelling Initiative as they develop multimedia stories.
Background working in higher education and coordinating academic or stakeholder events.
Proficiency in calendar management, social media management (LinkedIn), and presentation design using Google Workspace and Canva.
Strong written and verbal communication skills across diverse internal and external audiences.
